mapper.sql: a.address, a.camera_id, a.camera_model, a.pms_id, e.dict_note as camera_model_name, a.camera_name, a.alias_name, a.record_id, a.monitor_id, a.vendor_id , b.dict_note as vendorName , a.camera_type, d.dict_note as camera_type_name, a.channel_num, a.camera_num, a.sms_id, a.rms_id, a.stream_type, a.protocol_type, a.camera_ip, a.url, a.port, a.infread_port, a.camera_manager, IF(IFNULL(a.camera_code, '') = '', a.camera_code, '••••••') AS camera_code, a.is_control, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.unit, a.up_region_id, f.region_name as up_region_name, a.commission_date, g.record_name
mapper.select: select a.device_id, a.device_name, n.device_mete_id, f.cruise_type, f.result_num, g.dict_note as cruise_type_name, n.instance_id, j.task_id, h.warn_id, h.warn_level as alarm_level, k.dict_note as alarm_level_name, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN d.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_img) THEN c.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(c.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', d.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(d.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', c.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName from t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance n on a.device_id = n.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON n.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection c ON n.cruise_id = c.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON n.cruise_id = d.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on n.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.cruise_type and g.col_name = 'cruise_type' LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result j on j.task_result_id = e.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_warn_info h on h.task_id = j.task_id and h.instance_id = n.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k on k.dict_code = h.warn_level and k.col_name = 'alarm_level' where a.device_id = (SELECT id from three_dimensional_relevancy where model_name = #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) GROUP BY instance_id

SELECT a.device_id, a.device_name, b.custom_name, b.device_mete_id, b.mete_name, ( CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(e.inspection_id) AND ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(e.inspection_name) THEN f.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(b.mete_name) AND ISNULL(f.preset_img) THEN e.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(e.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN b.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(e.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', f.preset_name ) WHEN ISNULL(f.preset_name) THEN CONCAT( b.mete_name, ' /', e.inspection_name ) END ) AS instanceName, d.cruise_type, g.dict_note as cruise_type_name FROM t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_id = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance d on b.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection e on d.cruise_id = e.inspection_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset f on d.cruise_id = f.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = d.cruise_type WHERE b.device_mete_id = #{modelName, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and d.cruise_type is not NULL

SELECT a.device_id, a.device_name, b.custom_name, b.device_mete_id, b.mete_name, d.warn_id, d.warn_content, d.alarm_source, e.dict_note AS alarm_source_name, d.warn_level AS alarm_level, f.dict_note AS alarm_level_name, d.warn_time FROM t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b ON a.device_id = b.device_id
LEFT JOIN t_warn_info d ON d.std_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e ON e.dict_code = d.alarm_source LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f ON f.dict_code = d.warn_level WHERE d.std_mete_id = b.device_mete_id
AND b.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId, jdbcType= VARCHAR}
ORDER BY warn_time DESC

select a.device_id , a.custom_id , a.device_code , a.device_name , a.alias_name , a.device_type , a.position_type , a.model_id , a.region_path , a.up_region_id , std.custom_name , a.custom_type , a.status , a.update_time , a.create_time , a.preset_id, a.camera_id, b.device_model, b.used_time, b.pms_type, b.pms_id, b.device_vendor, b.production_date , b.disable_date, b.last_maintenance, b.maintenance_count, b.organization, b.department, b.responsible_person, b.latitude, b.longitude, b.ip, b.port, b.voltage_Level, b.sequence_point , a.real_code , b.address, e.dict_note as deviceModelName, f.dict_note as deviceVendorName, g.dict_note as voltageLevelName, d.model_name as modelName, h.dict_note as deviceTypeName, l.pic_real_path, k.region_name as upRegionName, preset.preset_name as presetName, info.camera_name as cameraName from t_std_devicemete std LEFT JOIN t_std_device a ON std.device_id = a.device_id left join t_std_device_attr b on a.device_id = b.device_id left join t_dict_business e on device_model = e.dict_code left join t_dict_business f on device_vendor=f.dict_code left join t_dict_business g on voltage_level=g.dict_code left join t_std_metemodel d on d.model_id=a.model_id left join t_dict_business h on h.dict_code = a.device_type left join t_std_region k on a.up_region_id = k.region_id left join t_device_type_img l on a.device_type = l.type_id left join t_camera_preset preset on a.preset_id = preset.preset_id left join t_camera_info info on a.camera_id = info.camera_id where 1=1 and std.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}
SELECT id,is_camera from three_dimensional_relevancy where 1 = 1 and model_name = #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.device_id, a.device_name, b.device_mete_id, d.instance_id, d.cruise_id, e.camera_id, e.preset_name, f.camera_name, f.record_id FROM t_std_device a, t_std_devicemete b, t_cruise_point_instance d, t_camera_preset e, t_camera_info f WHERE 1 = 1 and a.device_id = b.device_id
and b.device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType = BIGINT} and b.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id and d.cruise_id = e.preset_id and e.camera_id = f.camera_id GROUP BY e.preset_id

SELECT b.preset_id as cruise_id, a.camera_id, a.record_id, a.camera_name, b.preset_name FROM t_camera_info a, t_camera_preset b WHERE a.camera_id = b.camera_id and a.camera_id = #{cameraId,jdbcType = BIGINT}

SELECT IFNULL(d.count, 0) AS count, b.dict_code, b.dict_note FROM t_dict_business b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.alarm_level, count(a.alarm_level) AS count FROM ( SELECT warn_level AS alarm_level, warn_id FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL ( SELECT defect_level, defect_id FROM t_defect_info ) ) a GROUP BY a.alarm_level ) d ON d.alarm_level = b.dict_code WHERE b.col_name = 'alarm_level'
SELECT a.model_name as modelName, a.`name` as titleName FROM three_dimensional_relevancy a

select a.plan_id, a.plan_code, a.device_id, a.up_region_id, a.robot_id, a.plan_name, a.type, b.dict_note AS type_name, a.plan_point_types, (select count(*) from u_patrol_plan_attr b where b.plan_id = a.plan_id) as total, a.create_time, a.update_time from t_cruise_plan a JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.type = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = "plan_type" where 1 = 1 and a.plan_code = #{planCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.device_id = #{deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.up_region_id = #{upRegionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.plan_name like concat('%',#{planName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.type = #{type, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.plan_point_types = #{planPointTypes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.plan_id in (SELECT DISTINCT d.plan_id FROM u_patrol_plan_attr d LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance e ON d.instance_id = e.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection f ON f.inspection_id = e.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset g ON e.cruise_id = g.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete h ON h.device_mete_id = e.device_mete_id WHERE e.device_id IS NOT NULL and h.device_mete_id= #{modelName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
order by a.create_time desc

select from t_camera_info a left JOIN t_dict_business b on a.vendor_id = b.dict_code and b.col_name = 'camera_vendor' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business d on a.camera_type = d.dict_code and d.col_name = 'camera_type' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e on a.camera_model = e.dict_code and e.col_name = 'camera_model' LEFT JOIN t_std_region f on a.up_region_id = f.region_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_recorder g ON a.record_id = g.record_id where 1 = 1 and a.camera_name = #{cameraName, jdbcType= VARCHAR} order by a.camera_id limit 1

SELECT a.robot_id, a.robot_code, a.robot_num, a.robot_name, a.nest_code, a.nest_name, a.robot_status, a.drone_type, d.dict_note AS drone_type_name, a.robot_ip, a.robot_port, a.light_ip, a.light_port, a.identity_manager,
IF ( IFNULL(a.identity_code, '') = '', a.identity_code, '••••••' ) AS identity_code, a.lnferad_IP, a.Inferad_Port, a.Inferad_username,
IF ( IFNULL(a.Inferad_password, '') = '', a.Inferad_password, '••••••' ) AS Inferad_password, a.phote_path, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, b.dict_note AS robot_factory_name, a.robot_factory, a.made_in, a.made_date, c.dict_note AS is_use_name, a.is_use, a.commission_date, a.up_region_id, f.region_name, e.dict_note AS robot_position_name, a.robot_position, h.dict_note AS drone_position_name, a.drone_position, a.robot_source, a.address, a.building_user, a.appearance_number, a.defect_record, a.repair_record, a.exit_putInto_record, a.remarks, a.record_id, a.channel_num_light, a.channel_num_inferad, g.record_name FROM t_robot_info a
JOIN t_dict_business d ON a.robot_type = d.dict_code AND d.col_name = 'robot_type'
JOIN t_dict_business d ON a.drone_type = d.dict_code AND d.col_name = 'drone_type'
LEFT JOIN t_dict_business b ON a.robot_factory = b.dict_code AND b.col_name = 'robot_factory' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business c ON a.is_use = c.dict_code AND c.col_name = 'robot_use' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e ON a.robot_position = e.dict_code AND e.col_name = 'robot_position' LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h ON a.drone_position = h.dict_code AND h.col_name = 'drone_position' LEFT JOIN t_std_region f ON f.region_id = a.up_region_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_recorder g ON a.record_id = g.record_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.robot_status = '在线' ORDER BY robot_id LIMIT 1
